title: Elodie and the Detention
author: Beatrix Eriksen
blurb: Mirabel Reyes, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent twenty years being so careful it hurts. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
